decision: Keep the headline claim at EXPLORATORY_SUPPORT and separate base-worktree evidence from later documentation publication and exact-commit closeout.
rationale: The package has one local retrospective attempt from one recorded producer. Structural verification and byte audit do not establish scientific correctness or independence, and no matching remote Linux run exists. The created_at value is the observed author timestamp from git show -s --format=%aI 0520b945e0b270db65e89ad261e920c8b4aa892c, used as the first repository-publication timestamp; it is not an experimental execution time.
